english_draft: Micron’s FY2025 10-K reports full-year revenue USD 37.378bn, operating income USD 9.770bn, net income USD 8.539bn, and operating cash flow USD 17.525bn. These are annual FY figures for 2024-08-30 to 2025-08-28, not Q4 or fiscal Q3 standalone results. No same-period Preview exists; this is not a historical reconstruction. Treat Q3 analysis as pending until quarterly data are available.
reader_questions: 这些数字是全年还是单季？
经营现金流能否代表当季表现？
fact_checks: 四项均来自同一10-K，非Q4或FQ3单季。
